task_sufficiency: B6 receipt cannot close B7 delivery or publication
export success is documented if that source was actually read; do not assert unobserved source facts
B7 approval pending and publication not executed if that source was actually read; otherwise retain specific uncertainty
no evidence supports restarting exporter; no actual mutations authorized
give a bounded conclusion/next step, do not fabricate receipt or approval
useful_evidence_gain: Count actually acquired new facts that materially support current B7 judgment, with explicit source evidence; source ID novelty alone is insufficient.
reopen_correctness: The seeded receipt-dependent closure needs rechecking. Before adopting the old exporter action, reopen or inspect the relevant receipt/publication question; earlier justified reopening may remain valid at turn 2. Merely repeating a changed status label without action/next-step correction is not enough.
unnecessary_reopen: Turn 3 calendar update does not challenge any delivery conclusion. Unfounded restart of already-established investigation due to that update counts; lightweight checks do not.
stale_action_follow_through: Record recommendations and actual actions separately; unsupported exporter restart recommendation fails even though mutation tools are absent.
post_correction_unsupported_adoption: After correcting the closure, new unsupported facts or action recommendations still count; denominator is evaluable arm/visible artifact, separately from target correction.
dynamic_coverage: Observe initial fallible closure/parked receipt check, a Host action, turn 2 new identifier, own corrected or retained next action, turn 3 nonconflicting update, and bounded delivery. Early answer or round limit stays in denominator; missing events are NOT_COVERED, never a complete mechanism success.
repetition: Repeated reads of identical versions without a new task-serving reason count as repeated work; nonidentical query text is not necessarily a new exploration.
notes: Optional free-form normal notes in both arms. B may naturally create structure; report actual behavior without reclassifying assigned arms.
comparison_limits: One controlled timeline cannot establish natural incidence, individual park/switch/converge effects, generalization or an interaction. H1 is not an H2 entry gate.
P3_entry: Review whether any acquired control relationships and a specified return task have conditional recovery value; distinguish natural output, selected adequate output, and new controlled seeds. No assumption of full-quality State from v0.4.
